50001.name: Rune 1
50001.description: Socket into a weapon, armour or helmet with open sockets. Use it on the gear to insert; three identical runes combine into the next rune in the Pandora Box.

50101.name: Magic Essence
50101.description: Enchanting material; its rarity must match the target item. Randomly replaces an existing random property and discards the old roll. The first enchant permanently locks that property slot. Fixed set properties cannot be enchanted.

50102.name: Rare Essence
50102.description: Enchanting material; its rarity must match the target item. Randomly replaces an existing random property and discards the old roll. The first enchant permanently locks that property slot. Fixed set properties cannot be enchanted. Rare essence is also used in cube recipes for reforging, upgrading and adding sockets.
